reference_sql:
WITH quarters AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025
  SELECT CAST(range AS DATE) AS quarter_start
  FROM range(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2026-01-01', INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
), events_eur AS (
  -- one row per subscription event, in euros
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT q.quarter_start,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date < q.quarter_start THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS opening_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= q.quarter_start AND x.event_type = 'new' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= q.quarter_start AND x.event_type = 'expansion' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= q.quarter_start AND x.event_type = 'reactivation' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= q.quarter_start AND x.event_type = 'contraction' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN x.event_date >= q.quarter_start AND x.event_type = 'churn' THEN x.mrr_eur ELSE 0 END), 2) AS churn_mrr,
  ROUND(SUM(x.mrr_eur), 2) AS closing_mrr
FROM quarters q
JOIN events_eur x ON x.event_date < q.quarter_start + INTERVAL '3 months'
GROUP BY q.quarter_start

  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS mrr_eur

solver.query:
WITH ev AS (
  SELECT e.event_type, e.event_date, e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS d
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
), m AS (
  SELECT CAST(x AS DATE) AS ms, CAST(x + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE) AS me
  FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-10-01', INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AS g(x)
)
SELECT m.ms AS quarter_start,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_date < m.ms), 0), 2) AS opening_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'new' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS new_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'expansion' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS expansion_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'reactivation' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS reactivation_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'contraction' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS contraction_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'churn' AND event_date >= m.ms AND event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS churn_mrr,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(d) FILTER (WHERE event_date < m.me), 0), 2) AS closing_mrr
FROM m CROSS JOIN ev
GROUP BY m.ms, m.me
